title: Depth of a mapped list of circuits
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\ell$ be a list of elements of a type $\alpha$, and let $f$ assign to each element a circuit on $n$ variables. The maximum depth among the circuits obtained by applying $f$ to the elements of $\ell$ equals the maximum, with value $0$ for an empty list, of their individual depths.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a list of elements of $\alpha$
$f$ maps elements of $\alpha$ to circuits on $n$ variables
